widgets.tracks.forced_only.description: Subtitles tab of the player's track selector. The row directly after Off: show only the forced subtitle in the language of the audio that is playing (the lines that translate foreign speech or on-screen text), or nothing when the episode has none. widgets.tracks.boost_dialog.description: Audio panel of the player's track selector (Plex Pass only, issue #266). Toggle row label; the On/Off read-out comes from the row's own switch state, not this string.

widgets.tracks.normalize_loudness.description: Audio panel of the player's track selector (Plex Pass only, issue #266). Toggle row label; the On/Off read-out comes from the row's own switch state, not this string.

widgets.tracks.enh_note_sidecar.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line note under the ENABLED Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when the subtitle on screen is an external file the app draws itself — reassures the viewer that turning the toggle on leaves it untouched. No jargon: never say sidecar/remux/burn.

widgets.tracks.enh_note_burn.value: I sottotitoli restano attivi. Il tuo server Plex rielaborerà il video per mantenerli, quindi l'immagine potrebbe apparire leggermente più morbida.
widgets.tracks.enh_note_burn.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line note under the ENABLED Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when the subtitle on screen is embedded in the file — turning the toggle on makes the server re-encode the video to keep it in view. No jargon: never say burn/re-encode/transcode.

widgets.tracks.enh_note_dv_off.value: Dolby Vision si disattiva mentre questa opzione è attiva. Il video viene comunque riprodotto in HDR.
widgets.tracks.enh_note_dv_off.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line note under the ENABLED Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows for a Dolby Vision source whose base layer is usable — turning the toggle on plays the HDR10 base picture without the Dolby Vision declaration.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_analyzed.value: Non ancora pronto per questo video. Il tuo server Plex deve prima analizzarne l'audio.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_analyzed.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when the carried audio track has no canNormalizeLoudness fact yet.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_dv_unusable.value: Non disponibile per questo video Dolby Vision.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_dv_unusable.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows for a Dolby Vision source whose base layer is not self-displayable (Profile 5).

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_dv_subtitle.value: Non utilizzabile con i sottotitoli su questo video Dolby Vision. Disattiva i sottotitoli per usarlo.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_dv_subtitle.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows for a declared Dolby Vision source with an embedded subtitle on screen — the server copies the video and silently drops the subtitle rather than honoring either ask.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_quality.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows ONLY when the quality in force is not Original (a fixed quality rung, or Auto currently on HLS); picking Original is the way in. Never shown under "Quality: Original".

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_converting.value: Non disponibile mentre il tuo server Plex converte questo video.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_converting.description: One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows whenever the Quality row reads 'Original · Converted' (Original picked, the server converting the video). Same fact as that row.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_forced.value: Non disponibile finché Forza Riproduzione diretta è attivo. Imposta Riproduzione diretta su Automatico nelle Impostazioni per usarlo.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_forced.description: One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when Settings > Force Direct Play is on, so the server never gets to change the sound.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_copyable.value: Il tuo server Plex non può aggiungerlo a questo video in questo momento.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_copyable.description: One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when Original quality is in force (or cannot be reached by picking it) but the video cannot be offered the enhancement as it plays: a relay link, a video the server must convert, a track pick the Original route could not follow. Deliberately generic: the viewer cannot act on the differences.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_refused.value: Il tuo server Plex non è riuscito ad attivarlo per questo video.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_refused.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows after this playback's server already refused or ignored the params once.

widgets.tracks.sub_burn_audio.value: Disegnati dal tuo server mentre converte l'audio.
widgets.tracks.sub_burn_audio.description: Subtitles tab of the player's track selector. One-line reason under the DIMMED Timing and Style rows while the subtitle on screen is drawn into the picture by the server because it is converting the audio (a remux, or the audio enhancement's own burn): the text is already in the video, so neither control can reach it. No jargon: never say burn/remux/transcode.

widgets.tracks.sub_burn_quality.value: Disegnati dal tuo server a questa qualità.
widgets.tracks.sub_burn_quality.description: Subtitles tab of the player's track selector. One-line reason under the DIMMED Timing and Style rows while the subtitle on screen is drawn into the picture by the server for any reason other than converting the audio (a quality-limited re-encode, a picture subtitle that must be burned): the text is already in the video, so neither control can reach it. No jargon: never say burn/remux/transcode.

widgets.tracks.sub_remembered_note.value: I sottotitoli che hai scelto per questa serie non possono essere mostrati con questo video.
widgets.tracks.sub_remembered_note.description: Subtitles tab of the player's track selector. A short reason under the first group of rows, shown only when the show's remembered subtitle choice was applied to this episode but this way of playing it can show none of it (the player cannot draw that subtitle itself and the server would have to re-encode the picture to do it), so Off is what is on screen. Wraps over several lines on the panel (three in English). No jargon: never say burn/remux/transcode.

widgets.tracks.style.description: Subtitles tab of the player's track selector. The drill-in row that opens the caption style pages (Size, Position, Color), and the title of that page.

widgets.tracks.style_size.description: Style page of the player's subtitle menu. Row label and page title for the caption size; its value reads out the chosen size (Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large, Huge).

widgets.tracks.style_position.description: Style page of the player's subtitle menu. Row label and page title for where the caption sits on screen; its value reads out the chosen height (Low, Middle, High).

widgets.tracks.style_image_note.value: I sottotitoli basati su immagini mantengono dimensione e posizione proprie.
widgets.tracks.style_image_note.description: Note under the Style rows when the subtitle on screen is a picture (PGS, VobSub): the Size and Position rows are dimmed because the picture carries its own geometry. No jargon.

widgets.tracks.style_styled_note.value: I sottotitoli stilizzati mantengono dimensione e posizione proprie.
widgets.tracks.style_styled_note.description: Note under the Style rows when the subtitle on screen is a styled script (ASS/SSA) that positions and sizes its own text: the Size and Position rows are dimmed. No jargon.

widgets.ass.invalid_regions.value: Il renderer dei sottotitoli stilizzati ha restituito regioni non valide
widgets.ass.invalid_regions.description: Message drawn in place of styled (ASS/SSA) subtitles when they cannot be shown.

widgets.ass.invalid_pixels.value: Il renderer dei sottotitoli stilizzati ha restituito pixel non validi
widgets.ass.invalid_pixels.description: Message drawn in place of styled (ASS/SSA) subtitles when they cannot be shown.

widgets.ass.overlapping_regions.value: Il renderer dei sottotitoli stilizzati ha restituito regioni sovrapposte
widgets.ass.overlapping_regions.description: Message drawn in place of styled (ASS/SSA) subtitles when they cannot be shown.

widgets.sidecar.fetch_failed.value: Impossibile caricare questo sottotitolo dal server
widgets.sidecar.fetch_failed.description: Message drawn in place of an external subtitle file that could not be downloaded.

widgets.sidecar.empty.value: Questo file di sottotitoli non contiene righe leggibili
widgets.sidecar.empty.description: Message drawn in place of an external subtitle file that contains no readable text.

widgets.badge.cc.description: Badge: the title has closed captions. The mark the explanation text browse.detail.closed_captions defines; keep the two in step. Latin CC is the international mark in Spain and in the be catalog's own explanation.

widgets.badge.sdh.description: Badge: subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing. Must match the abbreviation in browse.detail.sdh, which introduces it.

widgets.badge.ad.description: Badge: the title has an audio-description track. Must match the abbreviation in browse.detail.audio_description (es: audiodescripción, AD).

widgets.tracks.other_languages.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector. Row that opens the page of subtitle languages that are not the viewer's own, and that page's title.

widgets.tracks.search.open.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Row on the Subtitles tab that opens the page, and that page's title.

widgets.tracks.search.language.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Row that shows and changes the language being searched; also the language list's title.

widgets.tracks.search.results.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Section header above the subtitles the server found.

widgets.tracks.search.searching.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Shown while the server is still searching.

widgets.tracks.search.none.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The search finished and found nothing. An answer, not an error.

widgets.tracks.search.failed.value: Impossibile cercare i sottotitoli. La riproduzione non subirà interruzioni.
widgets.tracks.search.failed.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The server did not answer the search. Never alarming: playback continues.

widgets.tracks.search.denied.value: Questo server non consente a questo account di aggiungere sottotitoli.
widgets.tracks.search.denied.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The server refused the request for this account. Blames nobody; no retry is offered.

widgets.tracks.search.missing.value: Impossibile cercare sottotitoli per questo elemento.
widgets.tracks.search.missing.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The server could not find the item to search for.

widgets.tracks.search.bad_language.value: Impossibile cercare sottotitoli in questa lingua.
widgets.tracks.search.bad_language.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The chosen language has no code the server accepts.

widgets.tracks.search.retry.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Row that repeats a search that failed.

widgets.tracks.search.adding.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Read-out on a result row while the server downloads it.

widgets.tracks.search.added.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Read-out on a result row once the subtitle is in the item.

widgets.tracks.search.requested.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Read-out when the server accepted the download but it has not appeared yet.

widgets.tracks.search.add_failed.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Read-out on a result row the server could not add.

widgets.tracks.search.add_failed_note.value: Il server non è riuscito ad aggiungere questo sottotitolo. Provane un altro.
widgets.tracks.search.add_failed_note.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). One-line note under the results after a download failed.

widgets.tracks.track_ordinal.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector. Tells apart subtitle tracks that are otherwise identical; the number is the track's position among them.

widgets.tracks.kind_full.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector. Label of a nameless subtitle track that carries every line of dialogue (not forced-only, not SDH).

widgets.tracks.kind_commentary.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector. Label of a nameless subtitle track that transcribes a commentary.

widgets.tracks.capsule_later.description: On-video timing control of the player: subtitles are shown this much later than the file's own timing. The duration is already formatted, e.g. "0.3 s".

widgets.tracks.capsule_earlier.description: On-video timing control of the player: subtitles are shown this much earlier than the file's own timing. The duration is already formatted, e.g. "0.3 s".

widgets.tracks.capsule_original.description: On-video timing control of the player: subtitles use the file's own timing (no offset).

widgets.failure.play_auto.description: Failed-playback button: sets Direct Play back to Auto (the Settings value, saved) and plays the item again.
